earlier_scan.source_named: Boer, Bernardus de. 1950. Studie over het dialect van Hindeloopen; also T. van der Kooy 1937 De taal van Hindeloopen. Print-only dialect monographs, not found online.

sources.citation: Miedema, H.T.J. 1971. De friese namen voor de dagen van de week. Een inleiding tot vormen en vragen. Naamkunde 3: 36-49.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p.41 and p.47: in Hindeloopen (and extinct Molkwerum) the Old Frisian main stress remained on the FIRST syllable of the day-name compounds (Sende 'Sunday', Mende 'Monday' < Sennedei, Mennedei), 'in tegenstelling tot de rest van Friesland' where sunnandei > snein shows stress shift to the second element. A lexically restricted stress statement, not a general word-stress rule.

sources.citation: Kooy, T. van der. 1937. De taal van Hindeloopen: grammaticaal overzicht en woordenboek met een bloemlezing van Hindelooper proza en poëzie. 's-Gravenhage: Martinus Nijhoff.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Read the whole 'Overzicht der Hindelooper spraakklanken', 'Spelling', 'Kort overzicht der gebruikte lettertekens' and 'Spraakkunstige verschijnselen' sections: no general statement of where word stress falls. Stress is only flagged lexically in dictionary entries where it is noteworthy (e.g. 'Bie-nei, bijna. (Klemtoon op bie)', 'Ómwei, omweg. (Klemtoon op óm)', 'Ómhaig, omhoog. (Klemtoon op haig)', 'Harme-ling.. (Klemtoon op..)'), plus phrase-level remarks ('met klemtoon blijft het jó').

sources.citation: Versloot, Arjen P. 2026. West Frisian Dialect Classifications. Dialectologia, special issue 15: 65-96. doi:10.1344/dialectologia.2026.4
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Classification history; treats Hindeloopen as the most divergent mainland dialect; nothing on stress. Used for its bibliography (Miedema 1986, Miedema & Steenmeijer-Wielenga 1972, van der Veen 2001, Versloot 2012).

sources.citation: Miedema, H.T.J. 1986. Kenmerken van het uitgestorven Molkwerums dialect en van het Hindeloopens. Taal en Tongval 38: 46-78.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Historical-phonological feature comparison of Molkwerum and Hindeloopen; only stress remark concerns the place name Molkwerum/Molkwar ('De klemtoon ligt op de tweede lettergreep') and Frisian 'breking' as 'accentwisseling in diftongen'. No word-stress rule.

sources.citation: Hoekema, T.B. 1976. In Hylper stavering. Us Wurk 25.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Orthography proposal for Hylpers; nothing on word stress ('mei klam' only in the sense 'emphatically').

sources.citation: [Tijdschrift voor Nederlandse Taal- en Letterkunde 1952] discussion citing B. de Boer, Studie over het dialect van Hindeloopen (diss. Vrije Universiteit 1950).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; confirms De Boer 1950 is a VU Amsterdam dissertation (Van Gorcum, Assen) with phonology (blz. 43 monophthongs, 53 l-qualities).

sources.citation: Siebs, Theodor. 1901. Geschichte der friesischen Sprache. In Hermann Paul (ed.), Grundriss der germanischen Philologie, 2. Aufl., Bd. I, 1152-1464; Anhang 'Die Laute der neuwestfriesischen Mundart von Hindeloopen', pp. 1419-1425. Strassburg: Trübner.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: The Hindeloopen appendix gives the vowel and consonant inventory with Old Frisian correspondences (Siebs' own 1880s fieldwork); it contains no statement on word stress (only an incidental 'nu »nun« (mindertonig)'). No Frisian-wide Betonung section in the chapter either beyond 'Vokale der minderbetonten Silben'.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Hindeloopen Frisian' and (fy) 'Hylpersk'; Winkler 1874 Dialecticon, Hindeloopen entry (books.meertens.knaw.nl); Neerlandistiek 2019 & 2024 articles on Hylpers; Millarson languagedeath.com page (offline, the Internet Archive unreachable); Delpher whole-book scanned of Kloeke 1952 'Verzamelde opstellen' and 'Van alles en nog wat over Friesland' (1955).
sources.note: None of these contains a statement on Hindeloopen word stress; used for bibliography only.
